title: Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam
intro: A centre for Vedantic learning and spiritual growth, in the Western Ghats beside the Surabhi Saraswati river.

stats.label: Ashram founded by Pujyasri Omkarananda Mahaswamigal

aboutText1: The ashram at Theni was founded in 1995 by Pujyasri Omkarananda Mahaswamigal.
aboutText2: It is run by the Vedanta Sastra Prachara Trust, founded in 1992. The Trust's goal is to make the ashram a centre for Vedantic learning and spiritual growth.
trustLabel: Vedanta Sastra Prachara Trust · Reg. No. 226/1992
riverAlt: The Surabhi Saraswati river near the ashram
settingTitle: In the lap of the Western Ghats
settingText: The ashram lies in the Western Ghats, near the Surabhi Saraswati river. The setting suits chitta shuddhi, contemplation, meditation and prayer. Swamiji described it as a place of divine connectivity and inner peace. Visiting Vedanta teachers often hold classes here.
facilitiesText: The ashram provides clean, comfortable accommodation and food for devotees.
facilities: Adi Guru Sri Prajna Dakshinamurti Vidyapitham

quote.text: Only those who study the Gita can survive the sorrows and vagaries of life.

address: Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam, Chatrapatti Road, Vedapuri, Theni, Tamil Nadu 625 531
